summary: Manager, Market Risk candidate with ~7 years across investment risk analytics, multi-asset portfolio analytics, and institutional ALM at Moody's Analytics, EY, and Ortec Finance. Hands-on with VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization, risk decomposition and attribution, stress and scenario analysis, and derivatives sensitivities across fixed income, multi-asset, and pension mandates. Strong Python and AI-enabled workflow record. CFA charterholder with dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Engineering).

sections.heading: Independent Risk Oversight & Exposure Analysis
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity analysis, and portfolio risk outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional client portfolios ranging $5-25bn per engagement, cumulatively covering ~$50bn of assets across fixed income, derivatives, and multi-asset mandates.

Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; cross-check sensitivity and exposure consistency at the portfolio level to support independent risk assessments of investment strategies.

Oversee interest-rate and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, linking risk measures to portfolio positioning and market movements to support risk-aware investment decisions.

sections.heading: Stress Testing, Scenario Analysis & Risk Attribution
bullets: Led design and implementation of a multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across fixed-income and multi-asset exposures.
Architected configurable time-bucketed analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling sensitivity analysis, scenario, and exposure analytics used in asset-allocation and hedging decisions.
Embedded behavioral assumptions and macro stress overlays, linking market movements to portfolio-level risk attribution outputs reviewed by Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Analytics Automation & AI-Enabled Tooling
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation — reducing development cycle time ~30-40% on comparable modules, with human sign-off retained on governance-critical outputs.

Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on portfolio exposures, scenario impacts, and sensitivities — translating quantitative outputs into decision-ready insights for Heads of Risk and investment teams.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms on the PFaroe multi-asset analytics platform; advised on portfolio, risk, and ALM configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.
Translated investment-team requirements into structured development requests; contributed to successful migration of all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment to PFaroe.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and risk-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and implementation materials.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform; ran risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test robustness of allocation recommendations for institutional investors.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk under base-case and stressed environments for Canadian and international pension funds.

Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis and cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analytics across multi-asset mandates; presented findings to investment committees on duration, currency, and leverage overlay strategies.
Led onboarding and the inaugural ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) merger, validating the model capturing Funding Policy dynamics across three predecessor plans.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
